findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Objects uploaded without an explicit encryption setting, including the customer spreadsheet defined here, are not protected by a bucket-enforced encryption-at-rest policy.
The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so encryption at rest is not enforced for financial data written to it.
The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Versioning does not encrypt object versions, so stored operational data is not protected by a bucket-enforced encryption-at-rest policy.
The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Access logging and versioning do not protect the bucket's stored data with encryption at rest.
